The world of Flex

Your next find.
Your next big flex.

From your first purchase to your rarest pet, Flex is about turning a growing collection into something extraordinary.

01

Shop & collect

Discover items across a whole spectrum of rarities. Find a favorite, then chase something even rarer.

02

Earn & grow

Give your collection a place to shine. Place items on pedestals to earn income every second.

03

Hatch & discover

Rainbow Egg that make Flex, Flex. Hatch eggs and discover companions like Gold Dog and Flex Dragon.

04

Rebirth & rise

A fresh start with more potential. Rebirth resets your money and increases your earnings multiplier.
